title: GTA 6 Gets Its First Unboxing Video As Shipping Begins For Xbox & PS5

Manage Topics News Xbox GTA 6 Physical Edition Unboxing Xbox Series X Xbox Series S GTA 6 Gets Its First Unboxing Video As Shipping Begins For Xbox & PS5 Here's a look at what's inside the physical edition by Fraser Gilbert 10 hours ago Share: While Rockstar Games mentioned a date of November 12th for shipping the physical edition of GTA 6 for Xbox and PS5 the other day, we noticed other retailers stating the 11th instead, so it's no surprise that it's showing up in the wild. The first unboxing video for GTA 6 seemingly arrived overnight, racking up over 1 million views already on social media since it was posted. This specific video is for the PS5 version, but we expect no major differences for the Xbox version. Here's a look at the video: First unboxing of GTA 6 in the wild pic.twitter.com/4Qt0e1KPzi - GTA 6 Intel (@GTA6Intel) November 10, 2026 Since this was posted, other unboxing videos have also started to hit the web, like you see in the YouTube video at the top of this article. It clearly shows that GTA 6 comes with a download code, a separate code for Ultimate Edition content where applicable, and a double-sided poster as had been confirmed previously. It also now affirms that the poster contains the GTA 6 cover art on the front, and a piece of artwork for a female character on the back - not Lucia or Jason, but presumably a character that's heavily involved in the story regardless. We've obviously talked a bit about the physical edition of GTA 6 already this week, and you can vote in the poll below if you didn't get a chance the first time, but we thought an actual unboxing video was worth a bit of extra coverage - an opportunity to see exactly what you'll be getting inside the physical edition if you've opted for it. When it comes to Halo 5, only the collector's edition didn't include a disc, every other version did. And I'm not even convinced Xbox was the first to do this. If anything, Nintendo really popularized the whole "code in a box" trend with the Switch, along with publishers like Capcom, Ubisoft, and others. Not to mention PC gaming, or even games like God of War Ragnarök, whose collector's edition also shipped without a disc. But that's not really the point here. We're talking about the standard edition of GTA 6, not some small indie game made on a shoestring budget. Rockstar is going to make millions, if not billions, from this game. Including a disc in the box would have cost them what, a few extra cents per copy and a tiny hit to their margins? They could easily afford it. To me, this just looks like a decision aimed at squeezing out even more profit. That said, I wouldn't be surprised if they eventually release a proper physical edition a few months later.
